correctness.rationale: PASS: For the nonuniform ternary fixed point of 0→012, 1→02, 2→1, the binary Thue–Morse transition realization yields three groups of 2^j consecutive n-windows. The outer groups have odd one-count, distinct moment M1 mod n; the middle group has N1≡2 mod 4 and M1 separates all but half-turns, distinguished by odd zero count and M0. A 0↔2 interchange and telescoping transition imbalance distinguish the two outer groups. The four statistics N1,M1,N0,M0 are derived from scattered length-≤2 subsequence counts, giving ≥3n binomial classes; published p_x(n)=p_t(n+1)=3n supplies ≤3n. All j≥2; no claim outside dyadic n. Independent direct integer enumeration j=2..8 corroborates but cannot prove infinite scope.
